title: Strata, closed
summary: Your approved round-4 strata, with one change: the list on the right now follows the red. Whichever layer is red in the drawing, its row on the right is the one open (What it is / In practice), so the drawing and the text always show the same layer.
story: Right after the letter's "every quarter starts from zero", this section shows what Kelwin installs instead (three named layers and the one line that keeps what each quarter learned), and it hands the principle a system that now gives off one clear signal.
motion: Standalone: the heading rises in like every other section, with the list on the right and the “Find your weakest layer” link. Then the three layers drop in one at a time, 2.8 seconds apart. Each one lands red while it is installed and draws its own mark (lines of text, a route, a ring), and its row on the right opens at the same moment, with the list's usual smooth open and close. The row that was open closes as the new one opens. So: 01 red and Narrative Systems open, then 02 red and GTM Infrastructure open, then 03 red and GTM Intelligence open. While 03 is still red and open, the stack closes up and the measurement beside it changes from "3 layers" to "1 system". One line then draws from the bottom layer back up into the top one, ending in an arrow, and the ring on the bottom layer closes. Finally the red, and its open row, return to 01 and rest there. It takes about 9.5 seconds, plays once, and nothing loops afterwards.

On the homepage: the list and the link arrive with the heading, so there is always something to read. The drawing's sequence plays once, when about a third of it is in view. Nothing pins: the page scrolls normally, and scrolling away and back does not replay it.

Interaction: every row in the list is a button. Pressing one (click, tap, Enter or Space) finishes the drawing at once, moves the red to that layer and opens its row. The drawing and the list stay matched both ways. Someone using the keyboard who tabs into the list while the drawing is still playing also finishes it at once, so a row never closes while they are on it.

Layout: the list keeps the height of its tallest open row the whole time, so the section, the drawing's frame and the “Find your weakest layer” link never move while rows open and close. It re-measures itself if the text re-wraps (a narrower window, or switching to the Kelwin type), so this also holds in the second skin.
Reduced motion: the finished drawing shows straight away (installed, loop and ring closed, 01 red with its row open), with no timers. Pressing a row still moves the red and opens that row.
addressed: "Its respective thing on the right side also gets somewhat highlighted through that horizontal line": that thin line is still there. Now it marks the open row, which is always the red layer's row.

"The rest of the section that is being highlighted should also open up": done. When Narrative Systems is red, its row on the right is open in full (What it is / In practice). When GTM Infrastructure turns red, its row opens and Narrative Systems closes, then the same for GTM Intelligence. When the loop closes and the red goes back to Narrative Systems, its row opens again and stays open.

To give each open row time on screen, the layers now drop in 2.8 seconds apart instead of 0.8, so the whole sequence takes about 9.5 seconds instead of 5.5 and still plays only once. That is long enough to take in a row's title and the start of its text, not every word; pressing a row keeps it open for as long as you like.
The red layer, its callout beside the drawing and the open row are always the same layer: during the sequence, when you press a row, and at rest.
Nothing jumps: the list keeps room for its tallest row, so the section's height and the “Find your weakest layer” link stay put while rows open and close.

Your rule on figure labels: the row of four boxed labels under the drawing is gone, and the section has no figure numbers or captions anywhere. The drawing is re-centred in its frame so nothing looks left behind where the boxes were.
notes: ROUND 5 (founder note on 05: the list follows the red; standing rule: no figure labels). Changes, all inside the approved round-4 design: (1) ONE RULE: show(n) moves the red top face (with its 8px lift), the bright callout, the 1px current-row rule AND the open row (is-open + aria-expanded) together. It replaces round 4's mark()/select() split, where the automatic sequence never opened rows. (2) TIMING: slab drops 500 / 3300 / 6100ms (2.8s apart; each slab's inscription, nodes and callout keep their offsets from its drop); dimension 6700 (label 7000); close-up 7300 (700ms); return 7950 (1000ms; ring closes 800–1300ms after); red and row 01 back at 8800; settle 9500. Each row is fully open for about 2.4s during the run (360ms accordion ease), 03 for about 2.3s, then 01 rests. demoMs 9000. (3) STABILITY: the script sets the ledger's min-height to closed heads + the tallest open panel (+1px), measured with offsetHeight/rect so the homepage's page zoom is undone. A ResizeObserver on the row heads and panel texts re-measures it whenever text re-wraps (resize, late font, live skin switch); before this, switching to the Kelwin skin and opening row 02 pushed the door down 22px. Verified: section height, frame height and door position are constant in every frame of the run at 1440 (1343.8px), at 1280×720 on the homepage (1194.3px) and at 390 wide (1860.9px), and across repeated presses. (4) TITLE BLOCK REMOVED, with its CSS, its entrance gate and the Installed/Exploded label script. The frame is now a flex column whose field stretches to the reading column's reserved height (657px at 1440, was 636 including the 56px box), and the drawing is centred in it (top: 50% − 286px, where 286 is the installed stack's centre): 110px above the stack, 109px below. The section is 20px taller than round 4 (1344 vs 1324) because the frame now matches the tallest open row plus the door. TESTS (work/system-r5): seq.mjs records every frame of the run (0 out-of-sync frames at 1440 and 390); interact.mjs: a press on 03 at 4.5s jumps straight to rest with 03 red and open and no timers left after; Enter and Space work; reduced motion shows 01 red and open with zero class changes over 5s. homeseq.mjs: on the stitched page the run waits until the figure is 30% in view, stays in sync, and does not replay after scrolling away and back. mk PASS (strict); no console errors. COPY unchanged from round 4: statement 'Three layers. / One closed loop.', lede, the 'loop most teams run' note, ledger names and descriptors (the nav), What it is / In practice lines, the door 'Find your weakest layer →' to /audit and its tail. 02 What it is is a deletion-only trim of the live capability-data.tsx GTM Infrastructure overview, kept to the data, orchestration and CRM work Kelwin installs. No new numbers, years, clients or results. RED MAP: label square, rule, note label square, and the selected slab's top face. The return, its source node, the arrowhead, the ring and the current-row rule are paper. PRODUCTION: show(n) is one state value; the exploded/installed, unlooped and selection states are plain class toggles with CSS transitions, so they port directly to Motion with the timings above. REVIEW PASS (accessibility, no visual change at rest): tabbing into the ledger during the run finishes the drawing in place, so no row collapses under keyboard focus (also when focus is already in the list when the section initialises); the open row's button carries aria-disabled="true" because one row is always open (ARIA accordion pattern); closed panels are visibility:hidden once their close finishes, so screen readers only get the open row's text; the row focus ring is drawn 6px inside the row's height and 8px outside its sides, so it no longer cuts through the open panel's 'What it is' label.
